summary: Expose targeted sync telemetry alongside Nightlands storyboard metrics
context: Playtest cohort feedback highlighted the need for a shared view that correlates storyboard runs with targeted sync executions. A telemetry dashboard panel will help operators monitor cadence and detect regressions as cohorts expand.

directives.details: Emit explicit targeted_sync events from Alfa Zero UI into logs/alfa_zero/session_metrics.jsonl with trace_id, files_copied, and operator metadata.
Aggregate storyboard_run and targeted_sync events into a lightweight JSON or parquet feed under exchange/attachments/telemetry/nightlands_duet/.
Add a telemetry panel (existing notebook or dashboard) that visualizes duet runs, cooldown intervals, and targeted sync usage. Document access steps and snapshots.
Document the telemetry hook in planning/alfa_zero_nightlands_duet_storyboard.md and planning/alfa_zero_targeted_sync_scope.md, noting how operators can validate the data.
Record ledger entries, attach sample dashboard output, and file a completion report summarizing impact and future telemetry enhancements.

success_criteria: Targeted sync executions emit structured telemetry alongside storyboard runs.
Combined data feed stored and mirrored for dashboards.
Dashboard panel (or notebook) visualizes cadence for operators with documented access steps.
Documentation updated with telemetry guidance and report filed with evidence.
